label: Smooth symmetric shallow-squat calibration; not an individualized human load prediction

reference_parameters.source: de Leva (1996), as transcribed in FreeMoCap's official anthropometry implementation

assumptions: Sagittal plane only, two identical legs and equal support sharing.
Upper body, head and arms are one lumped segment with fixed orientation.
Segment lengths, foot size, upper COM and movement are explicit illustrative design inputs.
Reference mass/COM/inertia parameters are population assumptions, not measurements of this subject.
Ground reaction and COP are derived from whole-body Newton-Euler balance, not prescribed curves.
Net intersegmental force/moment is reported; cartilage contact and individual muscle forces are not inferred.
